about: Deep northern winter: the hole in the lake ice, the ski track, the snow in the yard, and the long dark with its lights in the sky.

pieces.name: skis
pieces.about: A pair of skis and their poles, carried on the back: red tips and a pole's basket rise over the right shoulder.

pieces.name: poles
pieces.about: The ski poles tucked under the arms and pointing back, worn while it skis: the skis are off the back and under it.

pieces.name: bib
pieces.about: A white race bib numbered 17, worn on the front over the ski suit.

pieces.name: steam
pieces.about: Steam rising off warm skin in the frost, worn on the back: a wisp curls up past each shoulder.

pieces.name: puddle
pieces.about: A puddle of meltwater it stands in, worn at the base: a drop falls from the towel's hem and rings the water.

pieces.name: lantern
pieces.about: A storm lantern carried at the hip for the long dark: its flame flickers behind the glass.

pieces.name: shovel
pieces.about: A snow shovel carried on the back, blade up: its square red scoop stands over the left shoulder.

pieces.name: snowball
pieces.about: A big snowball rolled and ready, kept at its left side.

pieces.name: feet
pieces.about: Two orange penguin feet, worn at the base: they peek out from under the coat.

pieces.name: penguin-flap
pieces.about: The little penguin on the crown with its flippers flung up: the flap swaps it in on every upstroke.

pieces.name: owl-left
pieces.about: The snowy owl on the crown looking left: the night watch's cheer swaps it in for the owl looking ahead.

pieces.name: owl-right
pieces.about: The snowy owl on the crown looking right: the night watch's cheer swaps it in for the owl looking ahead.

pieces.name: owl-blink
pieces.about: The snowy owl on the crown with its eyes shut: the night watch's cheer swaps it in for the owl looking ahead.

pieces.name: boughs
pieces.about: Spruce boughs weighed down with snow, worn on the back: two tiers of them stick out past each shoulder.

pieces.name: drift
pieces.about: A drift of snow banked round the foot of the spruce, worn at the base.

pieces.name: scarf-spin
pieces.about: The striped scarf's band alone, worn round the neck while it spins: the spin draws its tail flying.

suit.about: A one-piece ski suit in lime from the chest down, a collar seam at its top and a white stripe down each side.

suit-sky.about: A one-piece ski suit in sky blue from the chest down, a collar seam at its top and a white stripe down each side.

suit-bubblegum.about: A one-piece ski suit in bubblegum pink from the chest down, a collar seam at its top and a white stripe down each side.

towel.about: A white bath towel wrapped round the body from the chest down, a corner tucked in at the top and a stripe near its hem (blue on the white one, white on the others).

towel-aqua.about: A aqua bath towel wrapped round the body from the chest down, a corner tucked in at the top and a stripe near its hem (blue on the white one, white on the others).

towel-crimson.about: A crimson bath towel wrapped round the body from the chest down, a corner tucked in at the top and a stripe near its hem (blue on the white one, white on the others).

parka.about: A navy parka round the face and down to the ground: a zip, two pocket flaps, and a cream fur trim at the hem.

parka-plum.about: A plum parka round the face and down to the ground: a zip, two pocket flaps, and a cream fur trim at the hem.

parka-cocoa.about: A cocoa parka round the face and down to the ground: a zip, two pocket flaps, and a cream fur trim at the hem.

knit.about: A lilac knitted jumper round the face and down to the ground: a white two-row pattern across the middle and a ribbed hem.

knit-denim.about: A washed-blue knitted jumper round the face and down to the ground: a white two-row pattern across the middle and a ribbed hem.

knit-forest.about: A forest-green knitted jumper round the face and down to the ground: a white two-row pattern across the middle and a ribbed hem.

snowsuit.about: A padded sunflower snowsuit round the face and down to the ground: red mittens at the sides, a red hem, a zip and a seam at the waist.

snowsuit-denim.about: A padded washed-blue snowsuit round the face and down to the ground: red mittens at the sides, a red hem, a zip and a seam at the waist.

snowsuit-lime.about: A padded lime snowsuit round the face and down to the ground: red mittens at the sides, a red hem, a zip and a seam at the waist.

coat.about: A penguin's charcoal coat round the face and down to the ground, with a white front from the chest to the feet; a flipper it lifts is charcoal too.

coat-slate.about: A penguin's slate coat round the face and down to the ground, with a white front from the chest to the feet; a flipper it lifts is slate too.

coat-blue.about: A penguin's blue coat round the face and down to the ground, with a white front from the chest to the feet; a flipper it lifts is blue too.

spruce.about: A green spruce's coat from the chest down: two tiers of needles with clumps of snow lying along them and on its shoulders.

spruce-blue.about: A blue spruce's coat from the chest down: two tiers of needles with clumps of snow lying along them and on its shoulders.

spruce-slate.about: A frost-grey spruce's coat from the chest down: two tiers of needles with clumps of snow lying along them and on its shoulders.
